title: Two-Year Payment History Points for Northgate Card Late Fee Courtesy
content:
The history points in a courtesy reversal of a late fee on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account follow the account's late fees and returned payments over the last 24 months:

- where the courtesy late fee is the only late fee in that time and no payment was returned in that time, 12 points;
- where no more than two late fees were recorded in that time and no payment was returned in the last 12 months, but either a second late fee was recorded or a payment was returned more than 12 months ago, 6 points;
- in every other case none.

The courtesy late fee is the most recent late fee recorded on the account. A count over the last 12 or 24 months takes the entries dated after the same calendar day 12 or 24 months before today; a payment returned more than 12 months ago and within the 24 months is one dated inside the 24-month window but not inside the 12-month window.

| Late fees in the last 24 months | Returned payments in the last 12 months | Returned payments 12 to 24 months ago | History points |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (the courtesy late fee) | 0 | 0 | 12 |
| 1 (the courtesy late fee) | 0 | 1 or more | 6 |
| 2 | 0 | any | 6 |
| 3 or more | any | any | none |
| any | 1 or more | any | none |

Hypothetical case: a late fee 20 months ago and the courtesy late fee 2 months ago, no returned payments: 2 late fees and none returned, 6 points.
